profile.headline: Mobile Software Engineer at Punch Through

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Implemented a new feature for mobile appstore that allows users to purchase apps from anywhere without being redirected to the appstore.
- Improved customer experience by eliminating the need for customers to be taken out of their workflow to buy apps.
- Planned to be used by other services within Amazon to simplify purchase flow from appstore, such as the ads team.
- Worked cross-functionally with project managers from other teams to integrate with their service.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Worked with one graduate student and one professor to create a framework that simulates arbitrary cryptographic protocols using Java.
- The framework includes a set of simple primitive operations that users can use to build their cryptographic protocol, such as add constant, mod operation, and send network. An automatic scheduling algorithm was implemented to calculate the fastest possible runtime that satisfies the user created dependencies, as well as multi-core support.
- The research project was presented at PURE Symposium 2015.

projects.title: AncientCraft
projects.description:
AncientCraft is a tower defense game where the player survives waves of enemies. Includes random map generation, pathfinding AI, and different types of towers, developed using Unity and C# following component based design.
Responsible for map generation with artificial smoothing, mob AI using modified A* that takes into account the line of sight, and tower placement using finite state machines.

projects.title: Rougue (CS196)
projects.description: Built with C#, we developed a roguelike 2D dungeon game with procedural map generation, multiple floors, items, an inventory system, different types of enemies with AI, and many type of spells. The AI included pathfinding and automatic attacking of the player. The pathfinding uses A* algorithm with a priority queue specifically coded to work with our game.
